AIMIM Corporator Arrested for Sheltering Accused in TCS Conversion Case

AIMIM corporator Matin Patel was arrested for allegedly providing shelter to Nida Khan, an accused in a religious conversion case involving TCS. Following the arrest, authorities initiated demolition actions at Patel's residence and office. The case pertains to the alleged forced religious conversion of a TCS employee.
